label: Limitation of esse versus represented limiting principle
term: limitation of esse versus represented limiting principle
resolution: EsseLimited (DEF-ESSE-LIMITED) is limitation of a thing's esse in formal perfection, the q.7 notion. HasLimitingPrinciple (DEF-HAS-LIMITING-PRINCIPLE) is the analyst's three-disjunct proxy of composition, esse other than essence, or a prior being. No result identifies them or derives one from the other; SUBSISTENT-INFINITY-FROM-RECEPTION uses only EsseLimited. Neither is quantitative finitude (DISAMB-INFINITY).
